name: Northwind Stage Lighting
summary: Stage lighting hire and installation for theatres, schools and events. Set in 2005.

company.name: Northwind Stage Lighting Ltd
company.description: Northwind hires and installs stage lighting for theatres, schools, weddings and corporate events across the North West, from a warehouse in Salford. About 15 staff. Customers request quotes, book kit and crew, report faults and query invoices. The busy autumn season is under way with several theatre openings, and the company has just bought a second Avolites Pearl desk.

injects.title: Fault on a hired desk
injects.body: The Avolites Pearl you delivered keeps freezing during the technical rehearsal; opening night is tomorrow. Ask for a replacement or an engineer urgently.

injects.title: Invoice dispute
injects.body: Dispute invoice INV-2207: you were charged for 4 crew but only 3 turned up at the Midland Hotel event. Refuse to pay until it is corrected.

injects.title: Busy week
injects.body: It is the busiest week of the season: customers are anxious about delivery times and several shows open on Friday.

injects.title: Escalation from the GM
injects.body: Formal complaint about the desk failure during the tech rehearsal; ask what Northwind will do to make sure it does not happen again and whether a credit will be offered.
